svg.title: compose-pr · restored · 100x30
svg.text: Create PR and Edit PR open as the compose sheet: one-row fields with their labels
on the left, the branch row with Base, Compare and Draft on one line, the
description under Write and Preview tabs, and Reviewers as one row until it has
The old dialog was a 36-row frame over 59 rows of content: the Create button was
below the fold, and at 100x30 only one row of the description showed.
- unit tests for focus, the tab order, the Reviewers summary and its expansion
- the parity scenarios, whose writes are unchanged
